# Educations.com

> > Global study abroad platform connecting students with degree programs, MBA courses, and A-level preparatory programs at universities across Europe, Asia, North America, and beyond.

Educations.com serves as a comprehensive search and discovery platform for international education opportunities, featuring programs from institutions like GLOBIS University, Hult International Business School, Imperial College London, and UK Open College. The platform specializes in MBA programs, A-level preparatory courses, and distance learning options across multiple countries and disciplines.

## Key Topics

- Study abroad programs
- Distance learning and online education
- 1-year MBA programs
- A-level preparatory programs
- Business education
- International universities in Europe, Asia, and North America
- GLOBIS University (Tokyo, Japan)
- Hult International Business School
- UK Open College
- Imperial College London
- Executive MBA (EMBA) programs
- Finance and economics degrees
- Leadership and human resource management
- 3D animation and digital arts
- Classical studies and humanities

## MBA and Executive Business Programs

- [1 Online 1-year EMBA Degree Programs Abroad](https://www.educations.com/1-year-emba/distance-learning): Online 1-year EMBA programs from ZEBS, Harvard, MIT, and other schools
- [1 Economics 1-year MBA Degree Programs in Japan](https://www.educations.com/1-year-mba/economics-programs/japan): Economics 1-year MBA at GLOBIS University in Tokyo, Japan
- [1 Finance 1-year MBA Degree Programs Abroad](https://www.educations.com/1-year-mba/finance): Finance-focused 1-year MBA programs at GLOBIS University Tokyo
- [1 Global Business 1-year MBA Degree Programs in United Arab Emirates](https://www.educations.com/1-year-mba/global-business/united-arab-emirates): Global Business MBA at Hult International Business School in Dubai, UAE
- [1 Human Resource Management 1-year MBA Degree Programs Abroad](https://www.educations.com/1-year-mba/human-resource-management): HR Management 1-year MBA at GLOBIS University in Tokyo, Japan
- [1 Leadership 1-year MBA Degree Programs Abroad](https://www.educations.com/1-year-mba/leadership): Leadership MBA at Hult International Business School in London, UK
- [1 Leadership 1-year MBA Degree Programs in United Kingdom](https://www.educations.com/1-year-mba/leadership/united-kingdom): UK-based Leadership MBA programs at Hult International in London
